# QnALog 1.6.12

## Highlights

- Errata notes now follow the interface language. A new errata note is written with English section titles (`Replace`, `Noise`, `Notes`), a `Note:` first line and an `· Errata.md` file name when the interface is English, and with the existing Chinese structure otherwise.
- Section titles are recognized in either language, in any letter case, and the two languages can be mixed in one file. Corrections and noise added from the editor go into the matching section instead of creating a second set of titles.
- Two error messages from errata notes are now translated.

## User impact

The settings schema and API key storage are unchanged. Existing errata notes are not rewritten and keep working. The errata folder name `QnALog/勘误表` is unchanged in every language.
